propositions: Agents must fast-forward their own worktree (not the shared main checkout) after a Gerrit merge and before closing a ticket to ensure the rebar-ticket commit is reachable from HEAD for close verification.

The completion precheck at transition_close.py:153-161 reads git log from repo_root with ref=HEAD to verify the merged commit exists; uncommitted WIP in the shared checkout gets clobbered if fast-forwarded directly.
Documentation (AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md) lacks guidance on post-merge worktree synchronization, leaving agents without direction on the correct fast-forward discipline.

AGENTS.md close-discipline section must add a bullet stating: after merge, run 'git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main' from the contributor's worktree only; never touch the shared main checkout.
CONTRIBUTING.md must gain a new §2f subsection immediately after §2e (Submit) with identical two-part guidance: fast-forward your worktree, never the shared checkout.
